metaDescription: {appName} is a to-do app that only shows you the task that matters now. With your photo, PDF or web page always at hand.
heroLead: The to-do app that only shows you the task that matters now. Finish it and the next one appears.
manyLead: And you can only do one thing at a time.
oneLead: The current task fills the whole screen, like a sticky note. You don't move on to the next one until you complete it.
handyTitle: Your photo, PDF,|web page.|*Always at hand*
handyLead: Attach what you need to see: the timetable, the recipe, the map. Open the app and it's there, full screen, with no digging through your gallery and no reloading.
awakeLead: If you want. Turn on “Keep screen on” and what you attached stays in view, at a glance, without touching your phone.
awakeNote: Off by default. Works while a photo, PDF or web page is on screen.
lightLead: Turn on “Lock zoom” and the photo stays put: no zooming, no scrolling. Lay a sheet of paper on top and trace.
endLead: Coming soon to Google Play and the App Store.
endLeadPlayOnly: Now on Google Play. Coming soon to the App Store.
endLeadAppStoreOnly: Now on the App Store. Coming soon to Google Play.
endLeadBoth: Available on Google Play and the App Store.
